intelligence.essence: A smart post is ONE block, not auto-formatted, verbatim, public or private, share, images — a standard post on a beautiful intelligent block. And it is the ADD button on the bottom bar: tap ADD, "Which feed?", and you are adding a post. The real difference is who inputs it: a post is the customer's manual sharing — they write it, Naya does not rewrite it or input it for them. A smart note and a Naya note are Naya's input — the customer tells Naya ("smart note this" / "Naya note this") and Naya inputs the note. Three kinds, settled: smart post / Naya note / smart note. And the flip goes back in the activation PDF — it was wrongly removed as "invented", and he confirmed it again.
